input_text: Only two bus lines are required; a serial data line (SDA) and a serial clock line (SCL).
label_note: COMPLETE enumeration of the I2C-bus physical signals (lines) per UM10204 rev 7.0: SDA/SCL (standard, sec 3.1.1 'SDA and SCL signals', bidirectional), SDAH/SCLH (Hs-mode, sec 3.6 'the SDAH and SCLH signals'), USDA/USCL (UFm, sec 3.2.1 'USDA and USCL signals', unidirectional). Direction omitted: SDA/SCL/SDAH/SCLH are bidirectional (no single Input/Output) and the prose extractor yields none. Deliberately EXCLUDED as non-signals (interpretive boundary, documented for review): ACK/NACK (sec 3.1.6 — protocol conditions ON the SDA line, not separate wires), DDC (sec 4.6 — Display Data Channel, a different bus), SDR (an I3C standard-data-rate acronym). The set is complete, so document-level precision is meaningful here.
